verdict.rationale: Orrick's Technology Transactions practice page explicitly states the firm advises on dual-licensed (open source and proprietary) software and on 'open source policy development and compliance,' directly naming this capability as part of their service offering to tech companies. missing for 10: independent corroboration (case studies, client testimonials, or press mentions specifically about OSS compliance work) and a dedicated standalone page/tool for this capability beyond a single practice-page line item.
